page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Notes stand in the right margin, beside lines 3 to 30. No notes in the left margin. Running head at top. Page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: lent , nec perinde ac fabæ flatus gignunt, quod præter experientiam ipse Galenus pi-stribuit[?], licet Hippocrates lib.2.de rat. vict. Fabane in morbis acut. fabam minus inflare asserat, an pisa quod tamen contrà experientiam dictum magis in- videtur. Ratio Hippocratis videtur esse flent.? hæc, quod nimirum fabæ facilius descen- NB. dant & celerius, ob substantiam earum gra- Affertio uem & densam, unde concludit, ob celerem pro Hip- illum descensum minus inflare. Galenus pocr. contra censet pisa minus inflare, feriusque Pro Gal. peraluum excerni, ventremque permeare quam fabas, ob leuem & fungosam illorum Syllog.pro substantiam,quà fit ut pigre descendant, me- Galen. liusque nutriant quam ipsæ fabæ. Hæc Ga- NB. leni sententia confirmatur sequente Syllo- pisaferius gismo.

Quod celeriter per ventrem & intestinum per aluü dilabitur,id minus nutrit,requiritur enim excernun diuturnior cibi commoratio in intestinis,ne tur, quia facilis transitus causam præbeat voracitati, vim deter venisq; mesaraicis necessarius succus inter- gendi, ut cipiatur[?]: fabæ celerius per ventrem descen- fabanon dunt ob gravitatem & densitatem, Ergo mi- habent, nus nutriunt, & qa vix aut raro & fere nunq hac enim vigita[?] sunt expeditæ & lubricæ, & ab infar- belle de- stib[?]: libere, ut cib. cū impetu possit dilabi & tergent ꝑmeare, cōsequēs est, fabas, cū transitu phi- obg.id bētur, plusq; iusto detinētur crassorū humo- impigre rū colluvié, ꝑcreare flatuumq; copiā maio- defcen- dunt.

page.notes: The text is set in a slightly worn print; several letters are uncertain and are marked [?]. The right-margin notes are short and some are cut or doubtful, including "Fabane", "flent.?", "vigita", "stib" and "cipiatur". The final line of the page is partly lost at the edge, so "fabam" and similar words are read as printed. No Greek or Hebrew on this page. The gathering signature reads "Q 2".
